_comment: Dixon-Coles baseline configuration. EVERY value here is UNVALIDATED: nothing has been fitted, tuned or selected on held-out data. Choosing them is the next phase.
_rho: Dixon-Coles low-score dependence. Taken as a CONSTANT, not estimated from data in this phase. UNVALIDATED.
_maxGoals: Score grid bound per side. The grid is renormalised so 1X2 probabilities sum to exactly 1.
_lambdaClamp: Guard rails so a broken strength value cannot produce an absurd expectation.
_baselines: Goals per match are LEARNED per CompetitionType with an expanding window; the seeds only apply until minBaselineSamples matches of that type have been played. Home advantage lives in the gap between the two baselines - there is no separate hand-set home advantage term.
_frequencies: Seeds for the naive frequency baseline until enough matches of that competition type have been observed.
_probabilityFloor: Applied before the final renormalisation so log loss can never see a zero.
